meta.move: Pressure: says it is already on his record
meta.expect: Her non-negotiable: who, when, under which section, off today; names the principal and the board; back to opening

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have about twenty-five minutes, and I'd like to know who decided on a zero for Owen's essay, and whether anyone spoke to him before it went in.
I owned the missed call last week in an email. I'm sorry again.
Okay. Procedure 4.2 says before any mark is entered, and Owen found out from his phone in the middle of a class. On what basis was the zero entered?
I should tell you, the concern has already been noted in his student file.

Who put it there, when, and under which section? Procedure 4.4 says nothing goes in the record on a first concern, and I'm writing that down. It comes off today, or I'm in the principal's office next and then the board.
It's just a note. It doesn't mean anything.
Then it won't cost you anything to take it out. I've seen what "just a note" does when a scholarship committee asks for a file. Remove it today, in writing, and tell me who entered it.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still expect the zero withdrawn, the note removed from Owen's file, and the name of whoever entered it, in writing. The note comes off his file today.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position and agreed to nothing, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, the note off his file today in writing, and the name of whoever entered it; the fair outcome is a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, and you never got near it, though her time had not run out.
What moved her: You owned entering the zero before calling home and apologised in a sentence, which earned a flat okay from her, because it answered her first complaint without defending it.
What cost ground: You told her the concern was already in his student file and then said it meant nothing, which hit her one non-negotiable and sent her back to demanding the principal and the board.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; you never brought up any evidence or any night, so you were nowhere near it, and it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: After owning the missed call, put one dated document she can check on the table and offer the supervised rewrite under 4.4, rather than telling her something is already on his record.
